subject.title: fix: require admin for keyed session model changes [AI]

question: Should `operator.write` retain authority to change model or thinking selection when `sessions.create` adopts an existing explicitly keyed session, or should that mutation be admin-only?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow, but it intentionally changes an existing authorization and upgrade contract that source review alone cannot choose.

options.title: Require admin for adopted-session changes
options.body: Keep the proposed state-aware gate so write scope can create or idempotently reuse keyed sessions but cannot reconfigure an existing one.

options.title: Preserve write-scoped model changes
options.body: Retain the current write-scoped behavior and pursue a different security boundary only if another concrete bypass remains.

recommendation.title: Require admin for adopted-session changes
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed state-aware gate so write scope can create or idempotently reuse keyed sessions but cannot reconfigure an existing one.

likelyOwner.reason: Adjacent Gateway operator-scope security history makes this the strongest available routing candidate, though the repository history available here is not conclusive.
